title: The ds-slot font cache fetches only from fonts.gstatic.com and follows no redirect, whatever URL a paused request carries (CodeQL alert of release #395, round 3)
steps: S1: From the repository root run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/design/tracy-ds-slot/test/cdp-font-host.test.mjs
S2: Record the exit code, the '# tests', '# pass', '# fail' lines and the result of each test named in run.tests.
expect: Every named test is 'ok': fontFetchUrl keeps a fonts.gstatic.com address and gives null for a look-alike host, a user-info trick, plain http, another host carrying the gstatic URL in its path, a metadata address, an empty string and undefined; cachedFont never fetches for another host, fetches a gstatic font once with redirect 'error' and then serves it from disk, and treats a redirect as a miss that caches nothing.

selectors.ds-slot: fontFetchUrl and cachedFont (packages/design/tracy-ds-slot/scripts/cdp.mjs); cachedFont answers Fetch.requestPaused on fonts.gstatic.com

evidence: CodeQL check of the release PR #395 after #413: server-side request forgery at packages/design/tracy-ds-slot/scripts/cdp.mjs:32 (`fetch(url)` with the paused request's URL). Review of #414: a mocked 302 from fonts.gstatic.com to 169.254.169.254 was followed by the default fetch. Measured: without the host guard 'cachedFont never fetches for another host' fails; without redirect 'error' the two redirect tests fail; Node's fetch with redirect 'error' rejects a real 302; a real gstatic font (Inter, 324 820 bytes) is still served.
fence: Mechanism only: which address the cache fetches. Not covered: the CodeQL run itself (no CodeQL CLI on the machine) and a live browser lane.

tests: fontFetchUrl keeps the fetch on fonts.gstatic.com
cachedFont never fetches for another host
cachedFont fetches a gstatic font once
cachedFont treats a redirect from fonts.gstatic.com as a miss
